about: Phase 11, round 2 (26 Sep 2026): verse blocks the textbooks print that no earlier review had seen. textbook_verse.extract_poem did not clean footnote markers from an opening line («пайки1»), so blocks whose first line carries one were never found; after the fix, every such block in the poets' chapters was read with its lead-in. Accepted when the lead-in makes the chapter's poet the speaker, the book signs the verse with the poet's name, or the verse sits under the poet's printed title; elegies, verse by others, examples and prose are rejected. Published by tool/literature/publish_reviewed_blocks.py, which writes back 'recordIds'.
